_help: Naya app add karne ke liye 'apps' list mein ek block jodo: { "name": "App Name", "description": "chhota description", "version": "1.0", "apk": "https://...direct.apk", "icon": "https://...png (optional)", "banner": "https://...jpg (optional, badi photo)" }. 'apk' direct download link hona chahiye. icon/banner khali chhod sakte ho. Is file ko GitHub repo (main branch) mein apps.json naam se rakho - app khud utha leti hai, rebuild nahi chahiye.
